li.label: time for my dream
li.description: The council took me off the hauling so I can chase my dream. I'm not wasting a minute of it.

li.label: my dream was put off
li.description: I asked the council for help with the one thing I really want, and they told me to wait.

li.label: the council backed my dream
li.description: They put the colony's own silver behind my dream. I'm keeping a tally of every coin.

li.label: wasted the colony's silver
li.description: They trusted me with the colony's silver, and I lost it to a smiling trader for a crate of straw.

li.label: learning from someone who knows
li.description: We sit down every evening and I ask my questions. It's slowly starting to make sense.

li.label: volunteered as a teacher
li.description: My evenings have been promised to teaching someone else, and I wasn't asked first.

li.label: asked to teach
li.description: I've been asked to teach what I know, and my evenings are cleared for it. I've started saying "my student."

li.label: my dream was called foolish
li.description: One of them called my dream a joke, with the others listening. I can still hear them laughing.

li.label: a wager on my dream
li.description: There's a bet on me now. I'm going to win it, if only to see the look on their face.

li.label: an easy bet
li.description: If they pull it off, I cook for a week and apologize at dinner. I'm not worried.

li.label: dreaming side by side
li.description: We're up late most nights now over the same bench, planning both our dreams.

li.label: not allowed to leave
li.description: I asked to leave, and the council said no. The walls feel closer now.

li.label: asked to stay
li.description: They asked me to stay, and they meant it. Maybe I can follow my dream here after all.

li.label: a friend almost left
li.description: A friend nearly left with the next caravan, and now their pack is back under the bed.

li.label: they all believe in me
li.description: One by one, they each gave me a reason not to give up. I wrote them all down.

li.label: pitied at the table
li.description: They took turns cheering me up, all the way round the table. It felt like my own funeral, with me in the front row.

li.label: setting a dream down
li.description: They told me there's no shame in giving up my dream. Maybe so, but I still miss it.

li.label: my dream will be remembered
li.description: Whatever happens to me now, they'll know what I was trying to do. I held on to that all through dinner.

li.label: a dream written down
li.description: We stood together while one of us had their dream read out and written into the records. It was a strange little ceremony, and I liked it.

li.label: carrying a promise
li.description: I promised to finish a friend's dream if they can't. They held on to my hand a long while after.

li.label: told not to be morbid
li.description: I tried to talk about what happens if I don't make it, and they all changed the subject.
